purpose: Canonical federation-wide skill profile. Skills are SHARED behavioral instructions — not per-agent, not authority-gated. This is the single source of truth for all AAA warga agents.
design_principle: Skills ≠ Tools. Tools = WHAT you can do (per-agent, authority-gated). Skills = HOW you should do it (shared, tier-gated, behavioral). FRAME maps tools to agents. FLAME provides free inference. FED routes models. Skills provide the playbook.

governance.rule: A skill may exist on disk, but it is NOT valid at runtime until it passes permission, dependency, precedence, cost, and governance checks.
governance.loading_order: 000-substrate → 010-constitutional → 020-bridge → ... → 150-harness_specific. No domain or forge skill loads before substrate + constitutional gates.
governance.cost_classes: C0 (always safe) → C4 (approval-gated). Agents have budgets: lite≤C1, forge≤C3, constitutional≤C4.
governance.activation: Need-state routing, not name-first. Classify need → select tier → select skill.
governance.collision: DUPLICATE, OVERLAP, CHAINED, ALIAS, ORTHOGONAL. Unresolved DUPLICATE >72h → both HOLD.
governance.verification: 6-gate pre-load: filesystem, permission, dependency, harness, model, constitutional. Post-load: no-truncation gate.
governance.deprecation: Weekly sweep with decay metrics. KEEP, MERGE, DEPRECATE, HOLD, VOID. Broken + no owner >30d → VOID.
governance.no_pretending: The registry declares intended topology. Runtime is truth. Never confuse them.
